title: Ethereal Smoke Phantom
description: A surreal abstract painting depicts swirling, smoke-like forms rising from a dark, textured landscape. The forms transition from deep purple and teal at the base to lighter misty whites and blues as they ascend into a turbulent, ghostly figure against a black background.
prompt: A dark surreal abstract oil painting featuring turbulent swirling smoke forms rising from a textured earthy landscape with gold flecks. The smoke transitions from deep purple and turquoise at the base into ghostly white and blue vapors forming a mysterious phantom-like figure against a solid black background, with visible thick impasto brushwork and atmospheric depth.
